title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Core Mandatory Declarations
statute: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 & Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011 (Rule 6)

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identity
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or for imported goods, the name and address of the importer.
rules.failure_message: Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer name is missing or blank.
rules.remediation: Print complete legal name of the manufacturing company or pre-packer on the principal display panel.

rules.name: Complete Address Declaration
rules.description: Declaration of complete address including city, state, and pin code or identifiable geographic landmark.
rules.failure_message: Address is incomplete or missing postal identification.
rules.remediation: Ensure complete physical address with registered premises, city, state, and PIN code is legible.

rules.name: Generic / Common Name of Commodity
rules.description: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package shall be prominently displayed.
rules.failure_message: Generic or common name of the commodity is missing.
rules.remediation: Clearly state the generic identity of the product (e.g., 'Biscuits', 'Refined Sunflower Oil', 'Detergent Powder') on the display panel.

rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure or in number shall be declared.
rules.failure_message: Net quantity value not found or cannot be verified as numeric.
rules.remediation: Print net quantity distinctly in numerals of compliant height as specified in Rule 7 Schedule II.

rules.name: Standard Unit of Measure
rules.description: Units shall be standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, m, or N/units) without non-metric symbols.
rules.failure_message: Unit of measurement is either invalid or non-standard metric.
rules.remediation: Use valid SI/Metric unit symbols such as 'g', 'kg', 'ml', or 'l'. Do not use archaic units (lbs, oz, tins).

rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.description: Declaration of month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.
rules.failure_message: Manufacturing/Packing date is missing or not in standard MM/YYYY or Month Year format.
rules.remediation: Declare 'Mfg Date:' or 'Pkd:' followed by month and year in clear legible format (e.g., 08/2026 or AUG 2026).

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
rules.description: The retail sale price shall be clearly indicated as 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price ₹ / Rs. .... (inclusive of all taxes)'.
rules.failure_message: MRP is missing or does not include mandatory inclusive of taxes declaration.
rules.remediation: Print 'MRP ₹ xx.xx (incl. of all taxes)' distinctly on the package.

rules.name: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.description: Rule 6(11) (2021 Amendment): Declaration of Unit Sale Price per g/ml/unit where package net quantity exceeds standard threshold.
rules.failure_message: Unit Sale Price per unit/g/ml missing on package over specified quantity threshold.
rules.remediation: Declare Unit Sale Price formatted as '₹ X.XX per g' or '₹ X.XX per ml' alongside the MRP.

rules.name: Consumer Grievance Redressal Contact
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer in case of complaints.
rules.failure_message: Consumer grievance care telephone number or email address could not be verified.
rules.remediation: Print 'For consumer complaints, contact Manager - Consumer Care at: Phone/Email/Address'.

rules.name: Batch or Lot Identification
rules.description: Batch, lot, or code number distinguishing the commodity packaging consignment.
rules.failure_message: Batch or Lot code not detected.
rules.remediation: Ensure batch or lot number is clearly marked on the seal or label.
